description: We're Swal Mal — nine curious people learning, creating, and growing together.
summary:
Aim : To create an interactive, mission oriented space simulation game that combines real NASA datasets and allow user to experience how real data and engineering decisions can influence the mission.
Objective: Integrate official NASA datasets into realistic mission simulations and for users to design, simulate, test, and improve mission before launch.
details: Rocketeers is a mission oriented space missions game that use official datasets from NASA and transform into interactive learning and mission testing experience. Players can configure spacecraft, explore missions and change parameters and run simulations and see how it affects the mission. As, for tools and environments, we use VS Code for IDE, Typescript, Next.js, THREE.js, html and css. The project benefit students and beginners by making complex topic making easier to understand through experimentations. Our project hope to help turning scientific data into fun gameplay and learn while doing so. What we intended is to make space science more approachable while encouraging the user curiosity, problem solving, and quick decision makings.
